chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Makki, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

Be truly modest before God. They said: What should we do, O Messenger of God? He said: If you do so, then none of you should sleep except that he sees death before his eyes. Let him guard his head and what it contains, and his stomach and what it consumes. Let him remember the grave and decay. And whoever desires the Hereafter, let him abandon the adornment of the life of this world.

key_terms.استحيوا: Be modest/shy before God (istihya') - a form of spiritual shame that restrains one from disobedience
key_terms.الأجل: Appointed term of death (ajal) - the divinely decreed moment of one's death
key_terms.البلى: Decay/decomposition (bilan) - the physical deterioration of the body after death
key_terms.الحياء: Modesty/shyness (haya') - a central Islamic virtue combining shame, reverence, and moral self-awareness
key_terms.زينة الحياة الدنيا: Adornment of worldly life - the material pleasures and attractions of this transient world

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about being truly modest before God?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), through a chain tracing from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) back to his forefathers, instructed his companions on what true modesty (haya') before God entails. Rather than a vague spiritual sentiment, the Prophet gave four concrete directives: keep death constantly before one's eyes, guard the mind from sinful thoughts, guard the stomach from unlawful consumption, and remember the grave. This teaching reframed haya' as a comprehensive ascetic discipline for those seeking the Hereafter.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from `Abdullah b. Maymun al-Makki from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Be modest before Allah in the most rightful way. They said: What should we do, O Messenger of Allah? He said: If you do so, none of you will sleep except that he will see death before his eyes. You should guard your mind and what goes into it, as well as your stomach and what it consumes. You should remember the grave and misfortune. He who wants the Hereafter should abandon the adornment of the life of this world.
